t: What Does The Name Shantana Mean?
s: In South Asian contexts, it is often treated as a variant of Santanu/Santana or Shantanu (Sanskrit: Śāntanu), linked to roots meaning “peaceful,” “tranquil,” or “wholesome,” and to santāna, “offspring” or “continuity/lineage,” yielding readings such as “peaceful one,” “bearer of lineage,” or “continuity in peace.” This aligns it with Indian names like Shantanu (male) and Shantana/Santana (used for any gender in modern usage), and with related forms such as Shantika/Shantika- (peace-bringing).
